terms.comment: An old cooling-room noun with a recorded modern appliance sense. Traupman prints frīgidārium for refrigerator.

phrases.english: Keep the leftovers in the refrigerator.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: numbered food and kitchen sections · Lewis & Short: frigidarium

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF: printed pp. 70–73 (food and drink), 124 (refrigerator), 280 (blender), 358 (peanut butter), 383 (spinach). Printed page numbers are one less than PDF page numbers in this copy. The blender entry on printed p. 280 was also checked against its rendered page.
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
